name: Possession
description: Possession is the cross-cultural belief and reported experience that a human body and its functions can be controlled by an external agent — a spirit, ghost, demon, deity, or ancestor — producing dramatic changes in voice, behavior, language, and apparent identity. It is documented in 74% of 488 societies surveyed in a 1969 NIMH cross-cultural study.

aliases.name: Demonic possession
aliases.meaning: Possession by a malevolent spirit, in Christian and Islamic frameworks

aliases.name: Dybbuk possession
aliases.meaning: Possession by a disembodied human soul

origin: Beliefs in and reports of possession are found in the great majority of human societies. Bourguignon's 1969 cross-cultural survey identified some form of possession belief in 74% of 488 societies, with highest prevalence in the Pacific and lowest among Native American societies.
